method: Manually trace room 2315 from the actual PDF rendered at 600 dpi, including the four visible column intrusions. room.method: Follow the interior wall and column faces; close door openings along their surrounding wall line. Door arcs and emergency-equipment graphics are excluded. The separately outlined unlabeled recess east of the room is not assigned to classroom 2315.

limitations: The source is a 2021 emergency plan; later alterations cannot be excluded. Its room number and traced area agree with the current supplied Facilities listing.

Registration uses repeated structural tower corners between Levels 2 and 3. The resulting position inherits the approximate existing Facilities-to-campus fit and does not represent independent survey accuracy.
Existing floor heights remain estimated. The rest of the Level 2 floor plate is still copied from another floor and is not newly verified by this one-room supplement.
